title: Orders
description:
Straumann® AXS Lab Orders manages the end-to-end lifecycle of a lab order ensuring faster validation and seamless communication between clinics and labs. 

In addition, with Straumann® AXS Order Integrator service, we have a place where all AXS orders are displayed unified and with a speed up search of all orders generated.

title: Patients
description: The Straumann AXS® Patients enables you to create and manage the patient journey.

title: Webhook System
description: The Straumann AXS® Webhook System enables you to manage subscriptions to AXS-related events and receive notifications via user-defined callback URLs.
